Name: rule_CHS
Comments: Chalcone synthase (type III PKS, EC 2.3.1.74): acyl-CoA starter + 3 malonyl-CoA -> 2',4',6'-trihydroxyphenyl ketone + 4 CoA + 3 CO2. Hand-written; MetaCyc NARINGENIN-CHALCONE-SYNTHASE-RXN, KEGG R01613. Implicit-H rule like metacyc_generalized_rules.tsv.

Name: rule_FLS
Comments: Flavonol synthase (2-OG-dependent dioxygenase, EC 1.14.20.6): dihydroflavonol + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 -> flavonol + succinate + CO2 + H2O (C2-C3 desaturation of a 2-aryl-3-hydroxy-chroman-4-one). Hand-written; MetaCyc RXN-527 / RXN1F-93, KEGG R03126. Implicit-H rule; product C2/C3 written H0 so stereocentres from [C@H] SMILES desaturate.
